subject: Business Models
title: Escrow and Guarantees
description: Learn Escrow and Guarantees in one minute.

hook.text: Upwork holds the client's payment until the freelancer delivers. Neither side risks getting cheated.

buildup.text: Escrow removes the 'who pays first' dilemma. The platform holds the money as a neutral party.

discovery.text: Airbnb's $1 million host guarantee protects against property damage. The guarantee enables stranger transactions.

twist.text: Guarantee claims are often denied on technicalities. The promise of protection matters more than its delivery.

climax.text: Escrow and guarantees make impossible transactions routine. Without them, the sharing economy collapses.

punchline.text: Hold the money, guarantee the outcome. Trust is engineered, not assumed.

quiz.question: What problem does escrow solve in marketplaces?
